notes: Needs a person to open downloaded CSV and Excel files. Steps: as Ali, Submittals List > Export > what you see > CSV, then Excel; Export the whole table; search first, then export; put =1+1 in the Subject of a Draft and export. Expected: rows and columns equal the screen; the whole table adds every List field; under a search only the rows read so far; a formula-looking cell is written as text. (The export api, GET /v1/projects/:id/work-items/export, answers 200 with the same rows as the List; the files were not opened.)
